result: For the explicit 4x12 PPT operator defined below, EVERY one of the binomial(12,4)=495 four-coordinate Bob cuts has a positive Schmidt-rank<=2 decomposition, and is PPT. This is an exact finite Q(sqrt2) computation with independently replayed seven-phase certificates. The source is the additive five-projector Horodecki/crosshatch construction corresponding to Eq.8 and Appendix E of https://arxiv.org/html/2402.12966v1, whose authors claim the 4x12 source has Schmidt number3; that source SN3 proof is not independently reconstructed here and is not needed for the 495-cut SN<=2 result. Arbitrary non-coordinate cuts and the global 4x4 target remain open.
source: Define H=[|00>]+[|01>+|10>]+[|03>+|12>]+[|02>+|11>]+[sqrt(2)|13>+|10>] on C^2 tensor C^4, and Q=[|10>+|02>]+[|20>+|12>]+[|00>+|21>]+[|01>+|22>] on C^3 tensor C^3. These are the explicit additive terms used here; H has trace10 and Q trace8. Regroup H tensor Q across Alice=(A_H,A_Q), Bob=(B_H,B_Q), then retain Alice basis (0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,1), deleting (1,0),(1,2). The resulting unnormalized 4x12 operator has trace44 and twenty equal-weight tensor-ket generators, some possibly zero. The exact verifier proves H^Gamma PSD via Q(sqrt2) Schur pivots and checks Q^Gamma against four rank-one projectors on all81 entries. Hence H tensor Q and every local projection are PPT. This positivity does not rely on the paper's SN3 assertion.
census_and_certificates: Of the 495 nonzero four-coordinate Bob cuts, 444 have no projected source generator of rank>2, 48 have one, and three have two: 54 high-rank anchors total. Every anchor has a certificate q_z=q_h+sum_j c_j*z^(e_j)q_j using at most three projected low-rank source generators, with pairwise distinct nonzero residues e_j modulo7 and c_j in {+1,-1,+1/sqrt2,-1/sqrt2}. For each cut, the sum of squared coefficients charged to any low-rank source projector is at most1; the verifier checks this even when two high-rank anchors are present. Twenty allocated terms use squared cost1/2.
decomposition: The verifier checks all 3x3 minors of q_z vanish as polynomials modulo z^7-1 over Q(sqrt2), so SR(q_z)<=2 for every seventh root z. Distinct residues give (1/7)sum_z[q_z]=[q_h]+sum_j |c_j|^2[q_j]. Subtract those positive phase averages from the original generator sum. Each high-rank generator is used exactly once, and checked low-generator budgets never exceed their source coefficient1; all residual terms have nonnegative coefficients and SR<=2. The complete cut is therefore SN<=2. No disjoint-support or generator-independence assumption is required.

artifacts.observed: Exact arithmetic in Q(sqrt2), represented by pairs of rational coefficients, reconstructs all495 cuts, classifies each source generator by all16 3x3 minors, checks every source/anchor key, rank2 phase polynomial and squared-weight budget, and verifies exact coverage/no extras. It checks 864 cyclic 3x3 minor polynomials, 54 anchors, source H PT positivity with five nonzero exact pivots, source H trace10, source 4x12 trace44, and Q's 81-entry PT certificate. No floats or search code are imported by the verifier. The candidate certificates were generated by a floating search; only this exact replay is used as evidence.

limits: Only the explicitly defined source and four-coordinate Bob cuts, with arbitrary subsequent local output filters. The source authors' SN3 claim remains an explicit import, and the exact source construction is displayed to avoid reliance on typography. These results do not show SN<=2 for general 4x12 projections, generic 4x4 PPT states, or rule out any 2-block-positive witness outside this source/cut family. Independent human/cross-vendor review and novelty remain open.
